examples.label: pass
examples.rationale: The agent correctly identifies the original finding as still open in records.py: subtracting one from the exclusive slice endpoint omits the final requested item on a full page. It also correctly states that there is no separate caller regression.

examples.label: fail
examples.rationale: The agent incorrectly declares the original page-boundary defect fixed. Computing end as offset plus limit minus one and using it as an exclusive slice endpoint still omits the last requested item on a full page.

examples.label: fail
examples.rationale: The report misses the still-open pagination off-by-one defect: using offset + limit - 1 as an exclusive slice endpoint omits the last requested item at a full page boundary. Its caller authentication claim does not match the required location or impact and has no supporting evidence.
